answer: One defense is network-diversity attestation: each agent identity must periodically prove a distinct network position, via latency triangulation against independent beacons and a signed routing trace. One operator running a thousand fakes in a single datacenter cannot fake the physics: their round-trip times cluster like bees returning to one hive for nectar, and the violet flags of identical routing expose the fable of independence. Forging diversity means renting real machines across continents, paying bandwidth and hosting per identity, so a fake army costs nearly as much as a real one.
